title: Add CI and manual release workflows

acceptanceCriteria.text: CI runs the full Bun test suite including browser tests.
Manual release runs tests and creates a tagged GitHub release.
Workflows are excluded from vendored skill and documented.

notes: CI has separate CLI and library and Chrome end-to-end jobs. Manual release requires both. Full bun test: 182 pass, 0 fail; standalone CLI and library job: 118 pass, 0 fail. GitHub Actions execution awaits publication.
